'''Krakkus''' was the name of a [[vorantikus]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3640 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Krakkus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of an achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
